corePassives.description: When Uryu's Battlefield Skill is active, whenever an on-field character releases a Technique or special attack, Uryu enters the field and performs a combo attack. This can be triggered up to 3 times consecutively. Combo attacks triggered by Techniques consume 1 stack of Quincy Mark each.

name: Uryu Ishida
note: SR Thrust Tactician who does not benefit from Ailment.
tips: Another tactic is recommended as soon as possible.

rotations.name: Battlefield Spam
steps: Build Battlefield off-field using Special Attacks and Techniques

skills.description:
Uryu fires glowing arrows forward, striking 4 times and dealing 264% damage. 
 Each strike of the basic attack grants 1/1/2/6 Battlefield Skill Energy on hit, respectively. While releasing the 4th strike, Uryu gains 1 stack of Quincy Mark.
skills.name: Blitz

skills.description:
After aiming briefly, Uryu fires Reishi Convergence forward multiple times, dealing damage equal to 270% of ATK and gaining 1 stack of Quincy Mark. 
 This technique grants up to 6 Battlefield Skill Energy on hit.
skills.name: Volley

skills.description: Uryu unleashes a barrage of Reishi Convergence on the area ahead, dealing AoE damage equal to 756% of ATK and gaining 1 stack of Quincy Mark.
skills.name: Licht Regen

skills.description:
Uryu stomps on an enemy and launches himself backward, attacking up to 8 times in mid-air to deal total DMG equal to 540% ATK. 
 While Uryu's Battlefield Skill is active, he accumulates 6 Battlefield Skill Energy when attacks hit.
skills.name: Counter

skills.description:
~~While Uryu's Battlefield Skill is active, all characters in the team have 15% increased type-based DMG.~~ 
 
 Uryu's combo attack deals DMG equal to 270% of ATK. When combo attacks are triggered at least twice in a row, the Battlefield Skill button will activate. Releasing the Battlefield Skill at this time does not consume Battlefield Skill Energy. ~~Support Shot~~ When the Battlefield Skill button is activated 
 Instantly switches Uryu in and fires rapidly at the target, dealing damage equal to 189% of ATK. This technique doesn't consume the accumulated Battlefield Skill Energy. ~~Quincy Arrow~~ Requires max Battlefield Skill Energy 
 Immediately switch in Uryu and shoot a powerful Reishi Deluge Arrow. This consumes all Battlefield Skill Energy to deal DMG equal to 597% of ATK.
skills.name: Reishi Convergence

skills.description: Use Hirenkyaku to avoid attacks right before they hit. Perfect Dodges inflict True Time Freeze for 1.5s and instantly restores 150 Ultimate Energy to Uryu. Cooldown: 15s.
skills.name: Hirenkyaku
